topics.title: Movie Revenue & Malibu Property
topics.summary: During an extended conversation, hosts Gary and Sam discuss their experiences attending a cast party for ‘Eight Million Ways to Die,’ involving encounters with Rosanna (a cat), Tom Hanks, Michael Douglas, Penny Marshall, and Eric Idol. They recount details about movie revenue discussions, personal finances – buying property in Malibu versus renting – and an awkward encounter attempting to woo a woman at the event.

topics.title: Vegas Confessions and Porsche Encounters
topics.summary: During an interview, the speaker recounts past encounters with Beverly D’Angelo involving a brief kiss in a Porsche, alongside a long-ago affair with Malika Warner characterized by bizarre behavior like driving in tuxedos and attempting to influence Saturday Night Live casting decisions. The conversation then shifts abruptly to discussing traffic gridlock caused by George Bush's visit and an incident involving a pilot who presented urine samples while wearing a towel.

topics.title: Charlie’s Street Comedy Mishaps
topics.summary: A chaotic and bizarre conversation unfolds involving Charlie Barnett struggling with reading after a failed SNL audition, accusations of drug use with a judge, strange street comedy gigs, and an apparent connection to Jim Jones' suicide attempts – all while discussing his potential role in a new TV show.

topics.title: Charlie Auditions for Weekly Readers - Hard Rock Cafe Chaos
topics.summary: Charlie auditions for a role reading weekly readers, hoping to regain confidence after three weeks of practice. The audition quickly devolves into chaotic interactions with Matt Goss and Debbie Kipson at the Hard Rock Cafe, culminating in an argument about bad hamburgers and a bizarre misunderstanding involving Elvis’s driver's license.

topics.title: Uncertainty and Responsibility
topics.summary: During a casual conversation, two individuals express disinterest in an unspecified event while debating the importance of taking responsibility for actions. They reference past experiences like Rodney’s departure from Caddyshack and discuss potential expenses related to attending an October 7th event.

topics.title: Repetitive Breast Discussion
topics.summary: The broadcast features a prolonged segment dominated by the repeated phrase ‘She’s gonna let her run away.’ Following this, there's an extended discussion about Meg’s breasts – their size and appearance - with callers offering opinions. Later, Sam discusses his recent vacation behavior including interactions with staff members and a reported phone camera incident.
